Computes time for completion against the Clause 8.2 730-day period from the Commencement Date, accrues delay damages at 0.1% of the Accepted Contract Amount per day under Clause 8.7, applies and enforces the 10% cap, and flags the point at which the cap is reached. Captures inspection and test plan records per BOQ work section: inspection lots, hold points, witness points, and test results, tied to the Earthworks and Preliminaries items so that QA sign-off gates progress-claim certification. Connects to the project EDMS for issued-for-construction drawings and

Maintains the controlled document register for the project, including the contract and BOQ as source-of-record documents, with revision tracking, provenance, and retrieval so every claim and QA record cites a registered document revision.

Tracks the Clause 4.2 performance security at 10% of the Accepted Contract Amount, records issue and expiry dates, and raises alerts ahead of expiry or on a change in the Accepted Contract Amount. Connects to the surety or bank that issues the guarantee.

Opens the Clause 11.1 365-day Defects Notification Period at Taking-Over, logs defect notifications and close-out evidence, and triggers the release of the second 50% of retention at the end of the period. Connects to the defects and maintenance system.

Classifies and verifies the evidence attached to each claim and each QA record, routes the certificate through the required approval chain, and fails closed if mandatory evidence is missing. Enforces segregation of duties between the preparer and the certifier.
